description: True landed cost per unit: material + labour + overhead + freight with GST input-tax-credit treatment, plus a suggested selling price from your target margin.
name: Cost Buildup Calculator

description: Breakeven sales uplift after a discount via the d/(m-d) formula — see how many extra units you must sell to keep profit flat, and flag unrecoverable discounts.
name: Discount Impact Analyzer

description: Compare base, optimistic and pessimistic scenarios on price, volume and cost, with an exact profit waterfall splitting the delta into price, volume, cost and fixed effects.
name: What-If Scenario Simulator

description: Per-SKU revenue, COGS, margin %, contribution share — ranked best to worst by profit rupees with a weighted average margin.
name: Product Profit Analyzer

description: Monthly margin % series with mean, standard deviation, ±2σ outlier flags, trend and a stability rating.
name: Margin Volatility Tracker

description: Checklist-scored leakage across discounts, wastage, returns, shrinkage and idle staff — estimated annual leak in ₹ with a risk rating and fix-first ranking.
name: Profit Leakage Radar

description: Herfindahl-style concentration over customers or SKUs: HHI index, top-1/top-3 shares, effective count, risk rating and what-if-the-top-leaves impact.
name: Revenue Concentration Analyzer

description: 12-month sales → seasonality index, peak/off-peak bands, suggested price multipliers (×1.05 / ×0.95) and an estimated revenue uplift.
name: Seasonal Pricing Advisor

description: Your price vs competitors per SKU: gap %, premium/par/budget positioning map and ±15% gap alerts.
name: Competitor Price Comparator

description: Weighted scoring of business options across criteria (weights sum to 1) with a ±20% sensitivity check on whether the winner survives.
name: Decision Support Engine
